text:
ana: FYI I opened a focused docs PR to add a compact "Observability quick-help" card for the console: short table (hit vs miss unit cost), a tiny tracing-hook example that shows latency + cost tagging, and two 1-liner SDK snippets (Java + Python). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1509 :sparkles:

matt: nice! can you link to the dashboard by ID? names have drifted before. prefer: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/DB-711-obsv-cost-latency

ana: (typo: i meant ana) — switched the link to DB-711. also kept the card to one small paragraph + the two micro-snippets so it fits the quick-help UI.

renee: quick checklist: 1) confirm metric names used in examples match the console alias (we've seen mismatches: kv_cache_hits vs kv_cache_hit_total); 2) mention tracekey is normalized as one word in SDKs; 3) add a 1-line troubleshooting tip for older dashboard templates.

ana: updated examples to use `tracekey` (one word) and added migration triage: "If charts show zeros, confirm alias mapping (runtime name -> console alias), e.g., kv_cache_hits -> kv_cache_hit_total, and check that a post-deploy redirect exists."

matt: can you paste the exact snippets here? keep them compact — reviewers like to see real code inline.

ana: pasted them in the PR but copying here for review:```java
// Java (micro-snippet): attach tracekey for cost rollup by prefix
Map<String,String> md = Map.of("tracekey","team42/featureA");
client.generate(prompt, md); // server: on cache hit -> metrics.inc("kv_cache_hits");
```

ana: ```py
# Python (micro-snippet): tracekey + tiny latency tag example
resp = client.generate(prompt, metadata={"tracekey": "acct-9/promo"})
# server-side: metrics.increment("kv_cache_hits"); metrics.tag("latency_ms", duration_ms)
```

renee: snippets look good. two small asks: 1) add a 1-line TTL note: "Short TTLs -> higher miss rate -> increased token spend." 2) add a sampling note: "If span sampling < 1.0, latency charts may be sparse; recommend ~0.1 in staging."

ana: added TTL + sampling bullets. Also replaced the metric name in the troubleshooting line with an explicit mapping example for clarity.

matt: CI will likely flag the external console link. add an allowlist comment in the PR so linkcheck passes, or alternatively reference the dashboard ID without a full external URL.

docs-bot: CI: docs build queued for PR #1509. linkcheck may flag external console URL as external; please confirm if intentional.

ux-bot: UX note: keep quick-card copy under 220 characters for mobile view. current draft is borderline; consider trimming the troubleshooting text and linking to a separate migration note.

ana: shortened the main card copy and moved the full migration troubleshooting to a separate "Migration & Triage" blurb linked from the card. Squashed small edits. Requesting @matt and @renee for final thumbs. :pray:

matt: LGTM pending CI allowlist comment. I'll add a tiny platform task to validate the alias mapping in staging once the PR is merged.

renee: LGTM, thanks! action items: 1) matt to validate alias mapping in staging + add post-deploy redirect if needed 2) docs to add allowlist comment for console link 3) ana to merge after CI green.

ana: thanks all — will merge once CI is happy. :white_check_mark:
